s: “Wings of Desire” is a 1987 film directed by Wim Wenders and set in Berlin, when the city was still divided by a wall.
“Asas do Desejo” (Der Himmel über Berlin) é um filme de 1987 dirigido por Wim Wenders e ambientado em Berlim, quando a cidade ainda era dividida por um muro.
Angels watch over people, listen to their thoughts and cannot touch the world.
Anjos observam as pessoas, ouvem seus pensamentos e não podem tocar o mundo.
One angel, Damiel, falls in love with a trapeze artist, Marion, and imagines becoming human.
Um anjo, Damiel, se apaixona por uma trapezista, Marion, e imagina se tornar humano.
Use the second conditional to imagine: “If I were human, I would meet her.”
Use o segundo condicional para imaginar: “If I were human, I would meet her.”
Ask “What would you do if…?” and answer “I would…”.
Pergunte “What would you do if…?” e responda “I would…”.
Say “If it were up to me…” to give your preference.
Diga “If it were up to me…” para dar sua preferência.
“Not in a million years” means never, and “just imagine” asks the listener to dream.
“Not in a million years” significa nunca, e “just imagine” pede ao ouvinte que sonhe.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: Ann Landers
s: “Ann Landers” was the name of a popular advice column that began in American newspapers in 1955.
“Ann Landers” era o nome de uma popular coluna de conselhos que começou nos jornais americanos em 1955.
Readers wrote letters about love, family and work, and she answered with common sense and humor.
Os leitores escreviam cartas sobre amor, família e trabalho, e ela respondia com bom senso e humor.
Millions of people read her advice every day.
Milhões de pessoas liam seus conselhos todos os dias.
To give advice in English, use “If I were you, I would…”: “If I were you, I would talk to her.”
Para dar conselhos em inglês, use “If I were you, I would…”: “If I were you, I would talk to her.”
The form is “if + were” and “would + verb”.
A forma é “if + were” e “would + verbo”.
Soften your advice with “Think twice” or “Trust me”.
Suavize o conselho com “Think twice” ou “Trust me”.
Be careful, and say “Fair enough” if you agree.
Tenha cuidado, e diga “Fair enough” se concordar.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: Fill in the Blank
s: A form is a document with blank spaces that you must complete, and in English there are two phrasal verbs for this: “fill in” and “fill out”.
Um formulário é um documento com espaços em branco que você precisa preencher, e em inglês há dois phrasal verbs para isso: “fill in” e “fill out”.
In British English, people usually say “fill in a form”, while Americans say “fill out a form”, but both are understood.
No inglês britânico, geralmente se diz “fill in a form”, enquanto os americanos dizem “fill out a form”, mas os dois são entendidos.
You may need to fill in a questionnaire, an application or a registration.
Talvez você precise preencher um questionário, uma inscrição ou um registro.
“Sign” your name at the end, and remember the date.
Assine (“sign”) no final e lembre-se da data.
“Apply for” means to ask formally: “I applied for a job.”
“Apply for” significa pedir formalmente: “I applied for a job.”
“Fill up” means to make something full: “Fill up the tank.”
“Fill up” significa encher algo: “Fill up the tank.”
Do not forget to attach every document.
Não esqueça de anexar todos os documentos.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: The Butterfly Effect
s: “The Butterfly Effect” is a 2004 science-fiction thriller starring Ashton Kutcher.
“O Efeito Borboleta” (The Butterfly Effect) é um suspense de ficção científica de 2004 estrelado por Ashton Kutcher.
Evan discovers that he can go back in time through his old diaries and change events in his past, but every change creates new problems.
Evan descobre que pode voltar no tempo pelos diários antigos e mudar eventos do passado, mas cada mudança cria novos problemas.
The title comes from the idea that a small event, like the flap of a butterfly's wings, can cause a big change later.
O título vem da ideia de que um pequeno evento, como o bater de asas de uma borboleta, pode causar uma grande mudança depois.
Mixed conditionals mix a past condition with a present result: “If I had studied, I would be rich now.”
Os condicionais mistos combinam uma condição passada com um resultado presente: “If I had studied, I would be rich now.”
Use “had + past participle” in the “if” part and “would + base” in the other.
Use “had + particípio” na parte do “if” e “would + base” na outra.
Example: “If Evan hadn't changed the past, his friends would be happier.”
Exemplo: “If Evan hadn't changed the past, his friends would be happier.”
Hindsight is easy, but you can still learn from your mistakes.
Olhar para trás é fácil, mas você ainda pode aprender com seus erros.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: The Road Not Taken
s: “The Road Not Taken” is a poem by the American poet Robert Frost, published in 1916.
“The Road Not Taken” é um poema do poeta americano Robert Frost, publicado em 1916.
A traveller stops where two roads separate in a yellow wood, and he chooses the one that fewer people have used.
Um viajante para onde duas estradas se separam num bosque amarelo e escolhe a que menos pessoas usaram.
At the end he says that this choice made all the difference.
No final ele diz que essa escolha fez toda a diferença.
Mixed conditionals help us imagine how a different choice would change our life today.
Condicionais mistos nos ajudam a imaginar como uma escolha diferente mudaria nossa vida hoje.
“If he had taken the other road, he would be somewhere else now.”
“If he had taken the other road, he would be somewhere else now.”
“If I had chosen another job, I would live in another city.”
“If I had chosen another job, I would live in another city.”
Who knows? Years from now, we may sigh and say, “Oh well.”
Quem sabe? Daqui a anos, talvez suspiremos e digamos: “Oh well.”

The next morning she wakes up as a thirty-year-old woman and discovers the life she wanted to have.
Na manhã seguinte ela acorda como uma mulher de trinta anos e descobre a vida que queria ter.
The film is a good example of how a wish can change everything.
O filme é um bom exemplo de como um desejo pode mudar tudo.

Para expressar um desejo sobre o presente, use “I wish + passado”: “I wish I could fly. I wish I had more time.”
With “be”, use “were”: “I wish I were taller.”

“If only” is stronger: “If only I could swim like a fish!”
“If only” é mais forte: “If only I could swim like a fish!”
A wish is only a dream, and wishful thinking will not change reality.
Um desejo é só um sonho, e pensamento positivo não muda a realidade.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
s: “The Rime of the Ancient Mariner” is a long poem by Samuel Taylor Coleridge, published in 1798.
“The Rime of the Ancient Mariner” é um longo poema de Samuel Taylor Coleridge, publicado em 1798.
An old sailor stops a wedding guest and tells him how he shot an albatross, a good-luck bird, and brought terrible punishment on his ship.
Um velho marinheiro para um convidado de casamento e conta como atirou num albatroz, uma ave de boa sorte, e atraiu um castigo terrível sobre o navio.
The crew dies of thirst at sea, and the mariner has to live with his guilt.
A tripulação morre de sede no mar, e o marinheiro precisa conviver com a culpa.
He could say, “I wish I hadn't shot the albatross.”
Ele poderia dizer: “I wish I hadn't shot the albatross.”
“Wish + had + participle” is the form for regrets: “I wish I had listened.”
“Wish + had + particípio” é a forma dos arrependimentos: “I wish I had listened.”
Use “never again” for a promise: “I will never do it again.”
Use “never again” para uma promessa: “I will never do it again.”
And say “What a pity” or “I am sorry” to show feeling.
E diga “What a pity” ou “I am sorry” para mostrar sentimento.

When we correct or clarify an idea, we use “in fact”, “actually” and “frankly”.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: Faust
s: “Faust” is a play in verse by the German writer Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, whose first part appeared in 1808.
“Fausto” é uma peça em versos do escritor alemão Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, cuja primeira parte apareceu em 1808.
Dr. Faust, tired of knowledge, makes a deal with the devil Mephistopheles: the devil will serve him in life, and Faust will serve him afterward.
O dr. Fausto, cansado do conhecimento, faz um pacto com o diabo Mefistófeles: o diabo o servirá em vida, e Fausto o servirá depois.
The condition is that Faust must never be satisfied with a moment.
A condição é que Fausto nunca deve se satisfazer com um momento.
To state a condition, use “as long as” and “provided that”: “You can borrow it as long as you return it.”
Para dizer uma condição, use “as long as” e “provided that”: “You can borrow it as long as you return it.”
Both are followed by the present: “Provided that you pay, I will help.”
Ambos são seguidos do presente: “Provided that you pay, I will help.”
“Terms and conditions” are the rules of a deal, and “strings attached” are hidden conditions.
“Terms and conditions” são as regras de um acordo, e “strings attached” são condições ocultas.
Read before you seal the deal.
Leia antes de fechar o negócio.

s: “The Ransom of Red Chief” is a short story by O. Henry, published in 1907.
“The Ransom of Red Chief” é um conto de O. Henry, publicado em 1907.
Two men kidnap a rich man's son to ask for a ransom, but the boy is so noisy and troublesome that they end up paying his father to take him back.
Dois homens sequestram o filho de um homem rico para pedir resgate, mas o menino é tão barulhento e travesso que acabam pagando ao pai para levá-lo de volta.
The story is funny because it reverses the usual deal.
A história é engraçada porque inverte o acordo habitual.
To set conditions, use “in return for”, “on condition that” and “as long as”: “We'll return him in return for two hundred dollars.”
Para impor condições, use “in return for”, “on condition that” e “as long as”: “We'll return him in return for two hundred dollars.”
To refuse, say “Not a chance” or “You must be joking.”
Para recusar, diga “Not a chance” ou “You must be joking.”
To accept, say “It's a deal.”
Para aceitar, diga “It's a deal.”
Negotiate carefully, and don't give anything away.
Negocie com cuidado e não ceda nada de graça.

s: “The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes” is a collection of twelve stories by Arthur Conan Doyle, published in 1892.
“As Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes” é uma coletânea de doze contos de Arthur Conan Doyle, publicada em 1892.
In each story, the detective notices small details and uses a method of observation and deduction to solve the case.
Em cada conto, o detetive percebe pequenos detalhes e usa um método de observação e dedução para resolver o caso.
His method is full of conditions: if he finds a clue, he follows it.
O método dele está cheio de condições: se encontra uma pista, ele a segue.
The zero conditional describes facts: “If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.”
O condicional zero descreve fatos: “If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.”
The first conditional describes a real future possibility: “If it floods, we will call the police.”
O primeiro condicional descreve uma possibilidade real no futuro: “If it floods, we will call the police.”
Compare: facts use the present in both parts; future possibilities use “will” in the result.
Compare: fatos usam o presente nas duas partes; possibilidades futuras usam “will” no resultado.
